description: Grade one Solana token mint for rug risk: 0-100 safety score, A-F grade and itemised flags. Free. Checks mint/freeze authority, Token-2022 traps (transfer fee, hook, permanent delegate, pause), mutable metadata, pump.fun curve status, top-holder concentration (wallets vs pools), liquidity, pair age, FDV/liquidity, volume/liquidity, buy/sell imbalance. Does NOT check LP locks. Use it before buying one token; to grade everything a wallet holds use wallet_sweep instead. Unknown or unlisted mints still return on-chain checks with found=false. Errors (isError=true): malformed mint. Live data from Solana RPC + DexScreener, typically 1-4 s.

mint.description: Token mint address (base58, 32-44 chars), e.g. DezXAZ8z7PnrnRJjz3wXBoRgixCa6xjnB7YaB1pPB263 (BONK). Not a wallet or pair address.
